local function createJumpscare(imageId, soundId)
	local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.CoreGui)
	local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel", screen)
	img.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	img.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	img.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. imageId
	img.ImageTransparency = 1

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound", game.SoundService)
	sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. soundId
	sound.Volume = math.huge
	sound.Looped = true
	sound:Play()

	-- Görsel Fade-in
	for i = 1, 0, -0.05 do
		img.ImageTransparency = i
		wait(0.01)
	end

	wait(3)
	screen:Destroy()
end

local function createInnerButton(text, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextSize = 18
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	Instance.new("UIStroke", btn).Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	btn.Parent = ButtonHolder

	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end
